Science in general is merely an estimate or rather approximation of the universe's rules. For example, compare Newton to Einstein to modern quantum theory. Newton is perfectly adequate for most things in our personal reality, Einstein is reliable for understanding most of space, and quantum is required for fringe conditions - but even the last has proven to give inaccurate results in many cases. Or follow the history of time - from the first mechanical clocks to the atomic models we have today, which while ridiculously accurate are still imperfect.
